name: Westchase Shopping Center
summary: Westchase Shopping Center is a 223,656-square-foot open-air retail plaza in Houston's thriving Westchase District, featuring popular chain retailers like Target, Petco, and Ross alongside casual dining options. The center benefits from exceptional daytime traffic from nearby office complexes and serves a growing trade area with strong household incomes.
demographics: Westchase Shopping Center serves a diverse, affluent professional demographic with a median household income of $64,536 within 1 mile, increasing to $74,722 within 10 miles. The trade area benefits from an exceptionally high daytime population of 44,904 within 1 mile due to nearby office complexes in the Westchase District, attracting working professionals for lunch, errands, and after-work shopping. The area also includes a Houston Community College campus serving up to 10,000 students, adding a younger demographic segment. The center draws from 26,837 residents within 1 mile expanding to nearly 1.5 million within 10 miles, with an average household income reaching $123,438 in the broader market, indicating strong purchasing power among suburban families and professionals.
description: Westchase Shopping Center is a premier retail destination strategically located at 11041 Westheimer Road in Houston's dynamic Westchase District, one of the city's most vibrant mixed-use business communities. Spanning 223,656 square feet of gross leasable area with ample parking at 6.42 spaces per 1,000 square feet, this spacious open-air plaza serves as a convenient shopping hub for the area's substantial daytime population generated by surrounding office complexes and the nearby Houston Community College campus. The center features a strong tenant mix of large chain retailers including Target, Petco, and Ross Dress for Less, complemented by casual dining options that cater to both the working professional crowd and residential shoppers. Its location in the Houston-The Woodlands-Sugar Land metro area positions it perfectly to serve a diverse and growing trade area with nearly 1.5 million people within 10 miles. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, Westchase Shopping Center combines accessibility, convenience, and a practical tenant mix that meets the everyday needs of Houston's west side communities.
